problem:
Which of the following systems of linear ODEs are decoupled?

- ${\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=-12{x}_{1}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=5{x}_{2}(t)\end{aligned}$
- ${\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=2{x}_{1}(t)+{x}_{2}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=5{x}_{1}(t)-3{x}_{2}(t)\end{aligned}$
- ${\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)={x}_{1}(t)+6{x}_{2}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)={x}_{1}(t)-{x}_{2}(t)\end{aligned}$
